_doc: Per-agent CORE skills (permanent, every project, auto-attached) — the project-type bundle from config/skills/global-skills.json comes ON TOP. Skill Boss validates before dispatch: an agent may not start without its core skills resolvable (real skill, playbook, ECC agent, or documented method) — missing → report + labeled safe fallback.
autoAttach: At team-build time the Lead (Boss) reads this map + the project-type bundle and embeds the skill list in each subagent's prompt (skills load via the Skill tool inside the subagent). No manual per-project reconnection.
honesty: Entries marked (ECC agent)/(method)/(tools) are agents, procedures, or tools — not SKILL.md files; they are invoked as what they are. Never claim a skill loaded that didn't.

_unshipped_removed_2026_09_23._doc: External audit II-E: these were the AUTHOR's global skills (~/.claude/skills), not part of the distribution, so on a clean install every Boss dispatch tripped the unresolvable-core-skill fallback by design. Known equivalents were remapped to the shipped Forge skill; the rest are listed here so the intent is not lost. An owner who installs them globally may add them back.
_unshipped_removed_2026_09_23._refilled: 2026-09-23 (external audit, measured): after the unshipped skills were dropped, ui-boss, seo-boss and skill-boss were left with EMPTY core-skill lists and nvidia-provider.test ("every registry agent has core skills") went red on every fresh install. Refilled from skills that actually ship: ui-boss -> forge-website/forge-mobile/forge-verify, seo-boss -> forge-website/forge-scout/forge-verify, skill-boss -> forge-scout/forge-skill-testing/forge-router.
